274729632.description: A natural Desert Rose Selenite mineral specimen featuring distinctive rosette crystal formations. Approximate size of 10 cm as shown in the image with the measuring tape for scale.

277192796.description:
Half of a natural geode with a hollow center lined in sparkling white and cream druzy quartz crystals. Small clusters of points fill the cavity, with faint yellow and tan iron staining across parts of the crystal surface. The outer shell is rough gray brown host rock with a flat cut edge, so the piece can rest on a shelf with the crystals facing out. No maker marks or labels are present. Sold as a single half, roughly 4 inches across.

Condition: Natural surface irregularities and mineral staining throughout. Some crystal tips are broken or chipped along the cut rim. Dust and loose grit in the cavity.
